# Code of Conduct

Tuple adopts the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/), version 2.1, as its code of conduct. The full text is available at that link.

In short: everyone taking part in the Tuple project — issues, pull requests, the Discord server, and any other channel — is expected to be respectful, welcoming, and constructive.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness behavior that goes against this code, please report it privately to the maintainer at **c0re_m4l@proton.me**. All reports are reviewed and handled confidentially, and the maintainer will respond as promptly as possible.
